items.title: District nurse ‘cuts’ to blame for rising end of life A&E visits, says RCN
items.summary: A decline in district and community nursing roles has led to a rise in people at the end of life having to turn to A&E departments for help, the Royal College of Nursing (RCN) has warned. RCN general secretary and chief executive Professor Nicola Ranger said there were now ‘too few’ nurses in the community...

items.title: Scotland’s hospices receive funding to match NHS pay rates
items.summary: Hospices in Scotland are being given government funding to provide their staff with pay parity in line with their NHS counterparts.

items.title: Assessing palliative care self-efficacy among long-term care nurses: validation of a modified scale
items.summary: Background: The self-efficacy of healthcare professionals is critical to the effective delivery of palliative services.

items.title: Inpatient palliative care delivery models: a systematic scoping review
items.summary: Background: There are multiple models for integrating hospital-based palliative care into healthcare systems. Further research is needed to inform best practice palliative care provision in hospitals. Aims: To identify palliative care delivery models in hospitals.

items.title: Palliative care in Mexico: a comparative analysis with the World Health Organization global framework
items.summary: Background: Access to palliative care remains insufficient in low- and middle-income countries, including Mexico.

items.title: Integrating artificial intelligence in oncology nursing for patients receiving chemotherapy: a review article
items.summary: Background: Artificial intelligence has the potential to improve symptom management and enable early intervention for patients receiving chemotherapy.
